limitation: No timing acceptance. Peak RSS reproduction is a prerequisite, not a substitute for allocator-object liveness or causality. Smaps is a later, non-atomic sampled state; syscall entries bracket a detection window, not individual page faults. Exact own-work/certificates permit provisional interpretation only when own Release RSS is reproduced. These are different solvers and their work is not equal; independent original SAT models and zero residue remain required.
